name: VERTICAL Gimnasio de Escalada
address: Jr. Nazca cdra. 6 s/n, Depor Plaza de Campo de Marte, Jesus Maria, Lima
research_notes: Own site is headed with 2026 opening hours and describes boulder plus sport climbing on about 125 m2 of wall. Location pin taken from the site's own Google Maps place link (not the embed centre). Inside the Campo de Marte sports complex, opposite the FDPN pool. Listed by the FEDPE directory as Vertical (@vertical.escalada).

name: Pirqa
research_notes: Own site describes about 450 m2 of walls with 15 m routes and two boulders, plus current weekday and weekend hours and classes. Coordinates are the business location the site itself publishes in its page metadata, not a visible map pin. Mostly a roped gym with a boulder cave; covered by Climbing.com in 2020-21.

name: Vertigo Valle Sagrado
research_notes: Own site (copyright 2025, embedded map generated Dec 2025) advertises a 65 m2 padded boulder area plus a 10 m rope wall, attached to a hostel and restaurant. Coordinates are the centre of the embedded map, kept at street precision because embed centres can be offset from the pin; not an exact entrance.

name: Mono Blanco Climbing Gym
research_notes: Own site shows weekly hours, address and harness-based classes on a 10 m wall; no bouldering offer is mentioned anywhere on the site, so bouldering stays unknown. OSM tags the node as boulder and sport (and member-access), which is not a primary source. Site footer says 2024; no 2025-26 dated post checked. Also runs rock outings and expeditions.

name: Templo de los Monos
aliases: Templo de los Monos Climbing Gym
research_notes: Own Instagram bio (readable) calls it a climbing gym with Mon-Sat and Sunday hours, but the bio and visible text do not say boulder. Directory pages and search snippets describe it as a bouldering-only gym with no ropes, so bouldering is probably yes but needs a primary check (post captions). No dated post was checked. Possible mix-up risk with Templo de los Monos monkey temple in Urubamba (not a gym).

name: Climbing Rooftop
address: Av. Roosevelt 216, Alto Selva Alegre, Arequipa
research_notes: Own Instagram shows hours, phone and a Sept 2026 membership post, plus a Moon Board story highlight; captions seen do not state a bouldering offer in words. The federation hosted its second 2026 boulder competition here on 12 Jul 2026 (federation page, not primary), so bouldering is very likely; needs a primary confirmation. OSM phone and house number match the Instagram bio and federation address. Federation sheet lists it as The Climbing roof (@theclimbingroof), possibly a variant handle.
